integrity: Self-contained exact finite checker and explicit arbitrary-context proof. Previously published length-thirteen threshold and example explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Complete classification is only for the binary one-gap three-deck at length thirteen. The arbitrary-context lemma is sufficient, not necessary. Exponential ambiguity is a lower bound at multiples of thirteen. No independent mathematical audit has been conducted.
title: Four minimal binary one-gap three-deck collisions and universal local substitutions
